query:
SELECT cohort_day, count() AS eligible, countIf(has(learning_days,cohort_day + INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS returned
FROM (
 SELECT distinct_id,countIf(event='analytics_enabled') AS has_consent,
 toDate(toTimeZone(minIf(timestamp,event='analytics_enabled'),'Asia/Seoul')) AS cohort_day,
 groupUniqArrayIf(toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Asia/Seoul')),event='learning_progress') AS learning_days
 FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-15 15:00:00','UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-18 15:00:00','UTC')
 AND properties.client='seodang-capacitor' AND properties.environment='production'
 AND event IN ('analytics_enabled','learning_progress') GROUP BY distinct_id
) WHERE has_consent > 0 AND cohort_day >= toDate('2026-10-16') AND cohort_day < toDate('2026-10-18')
GROUP BY cohort_day ORDER BY cohort_day LIMIT 100
